chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:

I asked him about the time of ghusl (ritual bath) of janabah: how much water is sufficient? He said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform ghusl with five amdad shared between him and his wife, and the two of them would perform ghusl together from a single vessel.”

key_terms.إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ: a single vessel from which both drew water
key_terms.صَاحِبَتِهِ: his wife or female companion in this context
key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ritual bath required after the state of janabah

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for ghusl of janabah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of ghusl (ritual bath) for janabah and states the amount of water that suffices for it. It reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, showing that a moderate amount of water was sufficient even when shared between him and his wife from one vessel.
